Bring Me Hope

A downloadable game for Windows

Buy Now$19.99 USD or more

THIS IS EARLY ACCESS


Bring Me Hope is a bittersweet adventure RPG about love, loss, and family. Explore a world of echoes and memories, where each battle tests your resolve and every secret whispers of something greater.

A story-rich experience about love, life, and connection. Sink into the unique and bittersweet life of Alium.




Features

  • A Handmade Experience — Created with love and care put into every pixel.
  • Overcome the Odds — High stakes and fast paced. Parry, dodge, or overpower your enemies.
  • Evolve and Experiment — Set grass on fire, electrify wet enemies, or use oil to create an explosive chain reaction. Items interact with fluids, objects, and enemies leading to unexpected results.
  • Heartfelt Story — An emotional adventure that will take you from the bottom of the ocean through cities and between planes of existence.
  • Fiendish Foes — Powerful and unique boss fights will challenge you to hone your skills and formulate new strategies.
  • More than Meets the Eye — Discover an unreasonable amount of hidden bosses and areas to explore.
  • Customize your Gameplay — Modify the game to fit your preferences! Minimize screenshake, max out the difficulty, and more.

How to play the Windows build on Steam Deck

  1. Add a "non-Steam game" to your library.
  2. Open Properties for the game.
  3. Go to Compatibility.
  4. Tick Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool to make it use Proton.

Testimonials

"The game is literally so aesthetically satisfying. It acts as a screensaver when coding on a different monitor and plays like a movie" -Jsmaniac
"I fell in love with the art style" -Vilgot
